# `federal_register_cfr_references`

**Federal Register typed CFR references (Layer 1)**

Physical typed child table (`federal_register_cfr_references.parquet`) holding one row per Code of Federal Regulations reference listed on a Federal Register document in zero-based source order, with native `BIGINT` `title`, `VARCHAR` `part` and `chapter` preserving mixed numeric/Roman/alphanumeric spellings, and `citation_url` (which legacy `federal_register.cfr_references` strips).

**Coverage.** Derived: one row per element of `cfr_references` on every document in `federal_register_documents` (from 1994-01-03 onward). *(measured 2026-11-28)*

**Data quality.** `part` and `chapter` are stored as `VARCHAR` so mixed publisher integers and Roman/alphanumeric strings (such as chapter `I` vs `2` or part `60a`) remain in one typed column without lossy casting. Preserves `citation_url` verbatim and tracks absent vs explicit `null` keys via `member_names`. Joins `federal_register_documents` on (`document_number`, `publication_date`) with native `DATE` equality; zero orphan rows are enforced on every build.

- **Parquet file:** `federal_register_cfr_references.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Parent document's reversible dated source identity (`document_number@YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Parent Federal Register document number; joins `federal_register_documents` with `publication_date`. |
| `publication_date` | `DATE` | Parent document's native `DATE` publication date; joins `federal_register_documents` with `document_number`. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:<hex>`) of the retained API page blob containing the parent document. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | Zero-based JSON Pointer (`/results/<doc>/cfr_references/<position>`) locating this CFR object inside the retained blob. |
| `position` | `INTEGER` | Zero-based ordinal position (`INTEGER`) of this entry in the parent document's `cfr_references` array. |
| `member_names` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of JSON keys present on this raw CFR reference object, distinguishing absent keys from explicit `null`. |
| `title` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` CFR title number (e.g. `40` for Title 40 CFR); NULL when omitted. |
| `part` | `VARCHAR` | CFR part identifier stored as `VARCHAR` so numeric and alphanumeric parts (e.g. `60`, `60a`) share one query column. |
| `chapter` | `VARCHAR` | CFR chapter identifier stored as `VARCHAR` so Roman numerals and integer chapters (e.g. `I`, `2`) share one query column. |
| `citation_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-stated CFR citation URL when present; omitted on legacy `federal_register` and preserved here. |
